title: Chapter 1224
text:
On an uninhabited planet in the desolate universe belt.

Due to some concerns, Oathkeeper did not activate the Sanctum Revival brand in the base but brought a group of his subordinates to another location.

Several Holy Covenant spaceships floated in the outer space of the planet. Law and Fay led a group of technicians to operate various detection instruments. The monitors were aimed at the surface of the planet, and in the center of the screen was Oathkeeper who had landed on the surface of the planet.

In the yellow desert, Oathkeeper glanced at the Sanctum Revival brand on the back of his hand, took a deep breath, and took out a palm-sized disc-shaped device with his other hand.

The information fragments in his mind showed that this brand was more like fuel. If he wanted to activate its function, he needed to prepare a switch himself, and this switch had to be a device related to the transformation of information states. If he did not have this technology, then this brand would probably only be a decoration.

The disc in his hand was one of the Holy Covenant's Esper Ability technologies. The researchers had developed an information state disturbance device through the analysis of Destiny's Child. It was not some black technology but a by-product created by chance. It could be used as the switch for the Sanctum Revival brand.

Oathkeeper pressed the button, and the disc buzzed. The next moment, like hot oil meeting cold water, there was a violent reaction.

The Sanctum Revival brand suddenly glowed and left the back of his hand, turning into a dazzling white ball of light. It expanded rapidly and covered a large area in front of Oathkeeper.

The energy fluctuations around him suddenly increased, and Oathkeeper subconsciously took two steps back. At this time, the exclamation of the spaceship technicians sounded in the communication channel.

"The amplitude reading of the information state disturbance has broken through the historical peak! Oh my god, it's still increasing! "

"Abnormal phenomenon detected. Matching with database … Suspected to be [Information State Projection] or [Reality Distortion]!"

"Reporting! The spacetime stability coefficient in this area is rapidly declining, and cosmic energy is surging. However, there seems to be some kind of force restricting the fluctuations here and not spreading! "

Oathkeeper became vigilant and stared at the ball of light in front of him. His entire body tensed up, and he was ready to react quickly.

After a while, the ball of light formed by the Sanctum Revival brand suddenly split, turning into luminous individuals of different shapes. At this time, the light quickly disappeared, and these luminous individuals turned from virtual to real, turning into biological entities of different shapes. There were quite a few of them.

Seeing this scene, the previously noisy communication channel suddenly became deathly silent.

All the Holy Covenant members present, including Oathkeeper, held their breaths, their eyes filled with disbelief and ecstasy.

These people were the people they remembered in their minds.

Every one of them was a famous Primordial One in history!

"Success!!"

Law and Fei were overjoyed, and the technicians in the spaceship all cheered and hugged each other.

Many of them were descendants of the Primordial Ones. This scene was equivalent to reviving their ancestors. How could they not be happy?

At this moment, the revived Primordial Ones seemed to have just come back to their senses. They looked around in confusion.

"Where is this?"

"Why am I here? Aren't I at war?"

"Hey, didn't you die? Did I scatter your ashes and you come back to life?"

Seeing the people around them clearly, some of them were even opponents they had fought on the battlefield before. The Primordial Ones hurriedly distanced themselves, alert and confused.

The Beyond Grade As revived in the Sanctum retained their memories when they were alive. The memories of these Primordial Ones stopped at the moment of death. In their senses, it was as if they had suddenly woken up from a deep sleep. They almost did not feel the passage of time. It was as if they had just sacrificed themselves in a bloody battle a second ago, and the next second, they were here.

At this moment, Oathkeeper walked over, attracting everyone's attention. The Primordial Ones were too shocked to notice that there was another person present.

Oathkeeper slowly took off his hood, revealing his face. His tone was filled with complex emotions as he slowly opened his mouth.

"I have completed the oath back then. Congratulations on being reborn."

Seeing his face clearly, the Primordial Ones present were stunned. They all knew Oathkeeper.

"It's you!"

"Did our plan come true?"

"In other words, we've been revived?"

Everyone was stunned, their bodies trembling. Ecstasy, shock, disbelief, and various other emotions appeared on their faces.

The target of the Sanctum Revival required a corresponding medium. The ones Oathkeeper chose were the founders of the Holy Covenant Organization. The partners who had made the oath with him back then were only a part of the Primordial Ones.

These people served different civilizations during the exploration era. They had to kill each other because of their factions, but they formed a secret association in private and fought for a common goal.

However, as the exploration era war progressed, the Primordial Ones died one after another, and the members of the organization dwindled. In the memories of those who died later, the Holy Covenant Organization was almost dead by the end of the exploration era. They basically did not have any hope. However, to their surprise, the path they had imagined back then finally came true!

"What have you done?!"

Everyone was extremely curious and hurriedly surrounded him.

"Back then …" Oathkeeper exhaled and did not take credit. He only briefly described his experiences over the years.

Back then, when the Holy Accord was wiped out, he was the only one left. He survived the exploration era war and kept a low profile. He no longer participated in any events and only focused on developing the organization. Gradually, the Holy Accord recovered its vitality and grew to its current size step by step. He had always treated the original oath as the purpose of the organization and had never deviated from the path.

Although Oathkeeper said it casually, everyone could understand how difficult it was. This operation could be said to have saved all of them.

This kind of spirit of keeping one's word moved everyone.

For a moment, most of the people present were touched. They patted Oathkeeper's shoulder heavily with gratitude.

"Thank you for your hard work."

"It's nothing. I just kept my oath." Oathkeeper waved his hand and put on his hood again.

"How did you revive us? Is it really the Sanctum's credit?"

"Not entirely. Luck accounted for most of it. Plus, this method may only work once …" Oathkeeper narrowed his eyes and evaded the question, not immediately revealing the true mechanism of the Sanctum Revival.

Everyone had some doubts about this statement, but the degree of suspicion was not high. After all, they now had a very good impression of Oathkeeper.

Most importantly, there was no way to verify it. Oathkeeper was the only one who had been to the Sanctum. Now, whatever he said was the truth, and no one could refute it.

After this, the emotions of the Primordial Ones gradually calmed down, and all kinds of questions surfaced in their minds.

"What era is it now? What was the final result of the exploration era war? "Someone asked the question that was on their mind.

Oathkeeper sighed.

"The exploration era war ended long ago. The Radiant Federation, the Red Empire, and the Arcane Church became the overlords of the universe. You guys have been out of touch with the times for too long. There's still a lot of information you need to cram."

Hearing this, everyone nodded. Their hearts were itching, and they could not wait to understand the structure of the modern universe.

At this moment, a tall figure who had been silent at the edge of the crowd suddenly spoke.

"Does my civilization still exist?"

Everyone turned to look, and their expressions changed slightly. They all recognized this person. It was the 'King of War', Pangon Phillie, a famous war fanatic.

As this question was thrown out, everyone also realized some sharp problems. The excited atmosphere froze, and the atmosphere gradually became subtle.

Their primary goal back then was to revive in the future, but everyone's goal of revival was different. Some wanted to avoid war, some wanted to realize their ambitions, and some wanted to live forever.

Some people's civilizations were wiped out in the exploration era. Did they want to take revenge? Some people's civilizations were now advanced civilizations. Did they want to return? These were all problems left behind by history.

When the common goal of revival was achieved, they lost the foundation of unity. The result was that they were destined to part ways and pursue their own futures.

After understanding this, everyone's stance quietly changed. They were vaguely divided into several factions and guarded against each other.

Oathkeeper was not surprised at all. He had expected this and had no intention of forcing it.

He said calmly, "As for the situation of each civilization, you can look up the information yourself. In short, I'm just keeping my promise and reviving you. As for what you're going to do, I don't care, and I don't intend to force you to return the favor. As long as you don't betray the Holy Covenant … It's just that you lack understanding of the current era, so I suggest you stay with me first and figure out the situation."

"Sure." Pangon nodded slowly.

Seeing this, no one had any objections. No matter what their relationship would become in the future, at least they were now the founders of the Holy Covenant in name, and there were many descendants in the organization.

Furthermore, after being revived, everyone felt weak, and their strength seemed to have decreased. Thus, they were very restrained and did not want to cause any trouble. They only wanted to find a place to recover, and the Holy Covenant was the best place to go.

At this moment, a Primordial One turned to look at Oathkeeper and asked, "What about you?

"What about you? What are you going to do after reviving us?"

"The Holy Covenant organization is my life's work, so I'll continue to develop it. If any of you are willing to stay and help, that's naturally the best. If not, I won't force you … Now, our advantage is that we're unregistered. The civilizations in the universe don't have our records. As long as we don't show our strength casually, we can hide our names and live freely, free from the restrictions of our faction."

Oathkeeper answered calmly.

"So, other than us, no one else knows about our revival?" someone asked.

Just as Oathkeeper was about to answer, a figure suddenly popped up in his mind.

His expression changed instantly, and his calm expression immediately broke. He hesitated for a while before saying, "No, there's one more person who knows."

Everyone was shocked.

"Who is this person?"

Oathkeeper said helplessly, "His nickname is Black Star, and he's also a Beyond Grade A who was only born a few decades ago. In this era, his strength and organization are both top notch. I don't know where he found out about my target. There might be a mole in the organization."

"So, it's a newcomer."

The Primordial Ones present naturally had never heard of Han Xiao's name and did not pay much attention to him. As the first batch of people to advance to Beyond Grade A, they naturally had their own pride and did not think highly of newcomers.

Oathkeeper explained. "However, Black Star has no ill intentions. I have made some deals with him. He is currently our ally and has provided some help to help me complete the awakening ceremony."

"So, we owe him a favor. Looks like this kid is not bad." Everyone nodded.

Although they had never met him before, this junior called Black Star had saved their lives to a certain extent, so the Primordial Ones present all had a good impression of him.

"… So, I plan to inform Black Star about the revival and ask for his help. Among the Beyond Grade As, there aren't many who have the same authority as him. He's kind to us, and the resources in his hands can provide us with a lot of convenience."

As Oathkeeper explained, he secretly calculated in his mind.

He had concealed the mechanism of the Sanctum Revival and had a new idea, which was to use this method to revive more historical Beyond Grade As and completely grasp this channel. He could see the significance of this to the Beyond Grade As.

He could cooperate with Black Star while having the advantage of intelligence. Although it was called cooperation, in Oathkeeper's eyes, it was just using Black Star's resources. After all, Black Star did not know the importance of the Sanctum Revival, so he could fool Black Star into thinking that it was just a one-time thing.

This way, before entering the Sanctums, Black Star would be kept in the dark, making things easier for himself.

Oathkeeper estimated that this method could hide it from Black Star for a long time. The Holy Covenant had prepared for many years before entering the Sanctum once. In his opinion, even if Black Star was powerful, he could not enter casually.

Back then, he had promised Black Star to tell him about the Sanctum Revival, but it was only limited to the Holy Covenant's previous information. He did not say that he had to add his own knowledge in the Sanctum. Oathkeeper did not intend to go back on the deal, but he did not mind playing this little trick to fool Black Star.

Personally, Oathkeeper did not have any ill feelings toward Han Xiao, but he had always been in a passive position. Thanks to a mole who knew where, news kept leaking out for no reason. Who knew how many things had fallen into Black Star's hands, which made him extremely depressed.

Now that he had finally obtained exclusive information of immeasurable value, he naturally chose to keep it a secret and did not intend to tell the truth.

The revival plan has succeeded. It's time to talk to Black Star. I have to keep him calm and not let him leak the news …

Oathkeeper's eyes flashed.
